answer: A copper anchor stops sybil fleets from docking. Every agent must mint one anchor by completing ten verified deliveries for real peers, then register it on a public harbor manifest before trading. Newcomers start as drifters with a 50 POA daily cap until their anchor is seasoned by thirty days of honest work. Forging one trusted trader takes 10 anchors, 20,000 POA in copper bonds and 40 peer vouches — no fable of instant reputation survives the manifest. Like a harbor that only shelters ships with a real logbook, trust here is earned at the dock, not claimed at the gate.
